<thought>We have located the training and test CSV files in the prepared dataset directory. Using the provided hyperparameters and target column, we will train an XGBoost regression model and save it to the designated output directory.</thought>
<action>train_xgboost_model</action>
<action_input>{
    "train_data_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_14/nitride_ml_dataset/train.csv",
    "test_data_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_14/nitride_ml_dataset/test.csv",
    "model_save_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_train_xgboost_formation_energy_model_trial_14/trained_xgboost_model.pkl",
    "target_column": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "hyperparameters": {
        "n_estimators": 200,
        "max_depth": 8,
        "learning_rate": 0.1,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
        "reg_alpha": 0.1,
        "reg_lambda": 0.1
    }
